༄༅/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i sgrub dkyil rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i sgrub dkyil rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam lhar/ /dang po nyid du phyag 'tshal te/ /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i sgrub dkyil bri/ /dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal sgrub rdzas phyi nang gi mchod gtor rnams phyag bzhes ltar legs par bsham/ sngon 'gro bgegs gtor btang la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ / bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /zhes brgya'am nyer gcig / sems bskyed ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /lan bdun nam lnga/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rnam dag nam mkha' lta bu la/ /rig pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ du shar/ /hūm̐ las 'od 'phros thams cad sangs rgyas zhing*/ /mnyam rdzogs byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las/ /rang nyid dpal chen che mchog he ru ka /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad/ /'khor lo mda' chen gtun shing tri shu la/ / ri rab bam dbyug rnge'u chung sgrog pa'i tshul/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'du ba'i lha rnams ma gtogs pa/ /dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /'di ru+u ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /ci ste 'gro bar mi byed na/ /mgo yang tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*/ / lus kyang dum bu stong dug gtub/ /rdul cha tsam yang med par byed/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛ ṇa gṛ ṇa hūm̐/ gṛ h+ṇa pa ya gṛ h+ṇa pa ya hūṃ/ a na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+yā rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku/ / dpal chen bdud 'dul rdo rje 'chang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur nas/ /gdug pa 'dul bar rab bsngags pa'i/

/me ri mtshon cha rdo rje'i rwa/ khro tshogs 'bar bas mtshams bcad do/ /ram̐ hūm̐ bh+rum̐ dhi ha ram̐/ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ phyag g.yon dril bu dku la brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ dang yig brgyas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho ma bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me muts+tsha badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes brgya'am nyer gcig gis rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sdom pa gzung ba ni/ hoḥ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ / rigs lnga'i bde bar gshegs pa ni/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /bla ma la yang skyabs su mchi/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs/ / byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig rjes bzung ste/ / rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa/ /dam tshig rdzas rnams bzung bar bgyi/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /nam du yang ni mi btang zhing*/ /rdo rje slob dpon mi btang ngo*/ /rdo rje spun sring rnams la yang*/ /nam yang smad par mi bya 'o/ /sems can rnams la 'tshe ba spang*/ /'phags pa rnams la smad mi bgyi/ /theg pa dman la mi brnyas shing*/ /gsang sngags spang bar mi bya 'o/

/ bsnyen sgrub las kyi mtha' bzung zhing*/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom par bgyi/ /dam tshig sdom pa la gnas shing*/ /'khrul pa'i bya ba mi bgyi 'o/ /rang gi sems ni yongs dul zhing*/ /phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i sems can gyi/ /don ni bla med bdag gis bsgrub/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ /ma bsgral pa rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyungs rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad nam mkha' la spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes dbang bskur byin dbab pa'o/ /phyag rgya bzung ba ni/ hūm̐/ thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon/ /'das dus 'gro rnams sad pa'i phyir/ / rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol/ /badz+ra dharma hūm̐ āḥ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la arga ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ bdud rtsi/ gtor ma/ rak+ta/ yul sa dang bar snang thams cad gcal du bkram pa/ dus 'khor pa ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ byed las zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can bskyed cing 'phags pa rnams mnyes par byed pa/ bkod pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ pād+yaṃ? pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dhū pe āḥ hūṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba ti gu h+ya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ bum pa sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du zhi ba kun tu bzang po yab yum skug mdog mthing ga rdor dril 'dzin par gyur/ thod pa nas bdud rtsis bsang*/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa/ las thams cad kyi bum pa dang bcas pa/ rin po che'i rang bzhin yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ lha'i gos pañtsa ki las mgrin pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ phyi bum pa'i dbyibs can nang lha'i gzhal yas khang chen po 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs rnam pa lnga ste/ dbus su oṃ dang e las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu+u ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum kun tu bzang mo dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /shar du hūm̐ dang bam̐ las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yub byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /lho ru trām̐ lam̐ las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che dang*/

g.yon des yu+u ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /nub tu hrīḥram̐ las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pad+ma dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /byang du āḥyam̐ las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /de dag kun kyang zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /yum rnams kyang sku mdog yab dang mthun cing phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon pas thod pa yab la stob pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la hūm̐ hūm̐/ trām̐ trām̐/ hrīḥhrīḥ āḥ.āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trām̐ trām̐/ hrīḥhrīḥ āḥ.āḥrnams las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ sems ma sgeg mo me long 'dzin ma dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /lhor byang chub sems dpa' sa yi snying po sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che'i myu gu dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ sems ma phreng ba ma ser mo phreng ba 'dzin ma dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /nub tu byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pad+ma dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ sems ma glu ma dmar mo pi waṃ 'dzin ma dngamanyam par 'khril ba'o/ /byang du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po sku mdog ljang skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che'i snye

ma dang*/ / g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ /sems ma gar lam ljang gu rdo rje rtse gsum 'dzin ma dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /shar lhor byang chub sems dpa' byams pa mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas klu shing dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ sems ma bdug spos ma dkar ser spos kyi ga'u 'dzin ma dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /lho nub tu byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pu+u sti dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ sems ma me tog ma ser mo me tog 'dzin ma dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /byang shar du byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ sems ma dri chab ma ljang gu dri chab 'dzin pa dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /de dag kun kyang byang chub sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso 'khor de dag thams cad la dbu rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub dpung rgyan/ do shal/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ smad rgyan/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs la sogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de dag gi mdangs las khyams kyi shar stod du lha'i thub pa dbang po brgya byin sku mdog dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ shar smad du lha min thub pa thags bzang ris sku mdog mthing ga go cha 'dzin pa/ lho ru mi yi thub pa shākya thub pa sku mdog ser po 'khar gsil dang par bu 'dzin pa/ nub stod du byol song thub pa seng ge rab brtan sku mdog sngon po pu sti 'dzin pa/ nub smad du dmyal ba'i thub pa chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog mthing ga me chu 'dzin pa/ byang du yi dwags kyi thub pa kha 'bar de ba sku mdog dmar po rin po che'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa'o/ /sgo bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du dzaḥdzaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bam̐ bam̐/ hoḥhoḥlas 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

shar sgor khro bo rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgo ma lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin ma dang 'khril ba'o/ / lho sgor khro bo gshin rje'i gshed po sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas dbyug to dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sgo ma zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin ma dang 'khril ba'o/ /nub sgor khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas lcags sgrog dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sgo ma lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin ma dang 'khril ba'o/ /byang sgor khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgo ma dril bu ma ljang gu dril bu 'dzin ma dang 'khril ba'o/ /de dag thams cad kyi sku+u la dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing me dpung gi klong na gyad kyi dor stabs su bzhugs pa'o/ /las bum du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan steng du hūm̐ dang bam̐ las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma kī dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi ba'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rgya gram gyi lte bar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par kyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i go zhubs dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ hrāṃ hrām̐ḥ.āḥlas de bzhin gshegs pa lnga steng gi nam mkha' la rang byon/ bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/

dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ dbus phyogs pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ shar phyogs pa la mi bskyod pa/ lho phyogs pa la rin chen 'byung gnas/ nub phyogs pa la snang ba mtha' yas/ byang phyogs pa la don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ gtso 'khor de dag thams cad kyi gnas gsum las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ skad cig gis 'gro ba sems can gyi don du spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ / bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ a la la hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub pa'i/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /yon tan rgya mtsho bum pa'i lha rnams la/ /dad pa rgya mtshos 'bul lo dbang bskur stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i

= /zhing khams rgya mtsho' = zhabs bsil = /yon tan rgya mtsho = dad pa rgya mtshos = /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pād+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i = /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i me tog = /yon tan rgya mtsho = /dad pa rgya mtshos = oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i = zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bdug spos = yon tan rgya mtsho = dad pa rgya mtshos = oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba rgyamatsho'i = zhing khams rgya mtsho'i snang gsal = yon tan rgya mtsho = dad pa rgya mtshos = oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i = zhing khams rgya mtsho'i dri chab = /yon tan rgya mtsho = /dad pa rgya mtshos = oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i = /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i zhal zas = /yon tan rgya mtsho = dad pa rgya mtshos = oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nai wid+yā āḥhūṃ/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho' = /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i sil snyan = /yon tan rgya mtsho = /dad pa rgya mtshos = /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nang mchod ni/ hūm̐/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs yid 'ong gzugs/ /rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs yid 'ong sgra/ /rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs su kun sbrul nas/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs dri zhim spos/ /rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs su kun sbrul nas/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs ro ldan zas/ rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su kun sprul nas/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la nai wid+yā kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs bde ba'i reg /rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su kun sbrul nas// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la spar+she kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūṃ/ hūm̐/ bla ma kun bzang thig le'i sku/ /nyag gcig mtha' bral longs sku'i rgyud/ /dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa yi/ /cir mi dgongs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhe sdang rnam shes rang grol dbyings/ /me long ye shes dkar gsal sku/ /chu khams rnam dag yab yum rol/ /mi bskyod yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags 'du shes rang grol dbyings/ /sor rtog ye shes dmar gsal sku/ /me khams rnam dag yab yum rol/ /snang mtha' yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug gzugs khams rang grol dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes mthing gsal sku/ /nam mkha' rnam dag yab yum rol/ /rnam snang yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nga rgyal tshor ba rang grol dbyings/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ser gsal sku/ /sa khams rnam dag yab yum rol/ /rin 'byung yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ / phrag dog 'du byed rang grol dbyings/ /bya grub ye shes ljang gsal sku/ / rlung khams rnam dag yab yum rol/ /don grub yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad/ /nyon mongs drug dang thub pa drug /ma 'gags rig rtsal sgo ba bzhi/ /phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/'od gsal ye shes sgyu ma'i lha/ /mtshan rdzogs dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing*/ /sku gsum lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdor sems yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bum bzlas ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/ bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams dang sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ dzi na dzikra/ lam̐ te shwa ra ti s+t+waṃ/ hūm̐ badz+ra dhāṃk/ mūm̐ dhā tu shwa ri s+t+waṃ/ swā rat+na dhṛk/ mām̐ mo ha ra ti s+t+waṃ/ aṃ a ro l̥kra/ pām̐ rā gar ti s+t+waṃ/ hā pra dz+nyā dhṛk/ tām̐ badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ/ zhes sam/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+na ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dha tu āḥ zhes rnam rgyal dang*/ las bum la yi ge brgya pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ bam̐ zhes brgya stong bzla'o/ /rjes su mchod bstod ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'og ma kun la 'gre'o/ /hūm̐/ bla ma kun bzang thig le'i sku/ /nyag gcig mtha' bral longs sku rgyud/ /dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa yi/ /cir mi dgongs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ / gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'od gsal ye shes sgyu ma'i lha/ /mtshan rdzogs dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing*/ /sku gsum lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdor sems yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod/ /badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis bum pa gang bar gyur/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni/ las bum nas bdud rtsi'i chu gtor zhing*/ a mṛ ta lan gsum gyis bsang*/ oṃ yo ga shud+dho sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad stong pa chen po/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ pam̐las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams kyang nang nas rim pa bzhin mthi ga /dkar po/ dmar po/ ser po/ ljang gu rnams kyi steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng na rdo karma sha sha las grub pa'i mda' yab dang rin po che'i drwa mig gseng mas bskor ba'i pu shus mdzes pa'i steng gtsang khang phyur bu'i rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes shing*/ phyogs bzhir rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i gdugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo/ shin tu mdzes pa'i ri dwags/ lha'i gos rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ yid du 'ong ba'i 'phan/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa gzhal yas khang mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ phyi rol na 'dod yon gyi snam bu la lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du+u ma thogs nas gzhal yas khang pa'i lha rnams mchod par byed pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad dang srung ba'i 'khor los brgyan pa/ /gzhal yas khang de'ang phyi nang med par gsal ba rgya khyon dpag tu med cing gzhal yas khang rgya tshad las 'das pa chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can no/ /de'i nang ka ba chen po brgyad kyis bteg cing rdo rje'i gdungs zhis mig mangs ris su phub po'i dbus su seng ge'i khri/ /shar du glang po che/ /lhor rta mchog /nub tu rma bya/ byang du shang shang gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri steng rnams su pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnam pa lnga ste/ dbus su oṃ dang e las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas 'khor lo dang*/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ /yum kun tu bzang mo dang mnyam par 'khril ba'o/ /lha tshogs rnams gong dang 'gre'o/ /de dag gi sku'i gdangs las steng gi bar snang la me ri me dpung gi klong na khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum la gau rī ma brgyad/ phra men ma brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi/ dbang mo nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sku la khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i steng gi nam mkha' la 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i klong na dpal kun tu bzang po yab yum la rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung du brgyud pa bla ma dam pa rnams dang bshad pa rgyud sgrub brgyud kyi bla ma/ bka' brgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi yi dur khrod la dbang phyug mkha' 'gro lang ka mgrin bcu'i tshogs/ /dpal sngags srung gi rgyal mo e ka dzā ṭi/ mgon po legs ldan nag po/ /bdud mor re ti/ shan pa srog sgrub nag mo/ gza' chen po rā hu la/ gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag /dam can rdo rje legs pa rnams ni 'khor sprul pa yang sprul pho nya las mkhan dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gter bdag dam can rgya mtsho/ /lha rabs mched dgu /brtan ma bcu gnyis/ yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs/ mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul/ bran g.yog sna tshogs dang bcas pa'o/ /lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar āḥ dmar po/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rgya gram gyi lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i go zhugs dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥlas de bzhin gshegs pa lnga steng gi nam mkha' la rang byon/ bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud ba las/ dbus phyogs pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/

shar phyogs pa la mi bskyod pa/ lho phyogs pa la rin chen 'byung ldan/ /nub phyogs pa la snang ba mtha' yas/ byang phyogs pa la don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ gtso 'khor de dag thams cad kyi gnas gsum las 'od 'phros/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ skad cig gis 'gro ba sems can don du spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥspyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cig /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ / bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ka dag spros bral chos sku'i zhing khams nas/ /bla ma kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje 'chang*/ / rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /ma lus spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /rang bzhin lhun grub longs sku'i zhing khams nas/ dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal gshes gnyen sogs/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /ma lus spyan 'dren/ /'gro ba 'dul mdzad sprul sku'i zhing khams nas/ /chos rgyal chen po ting 'dzin bzang po sogs/ /gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /ma lus/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga sems dpa' lcam dral tshogs/ /zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams/ / ma lus/ ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dpal chen he ru yab yum ke song sogs/ khrag 'thung 'bar ba khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams/ / ma lus/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /ye shes las grub dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /dpal gyi bka' sdod ci bgyis bka' nyan tshogs/ /ma lus/ dur khrod la sogs so so'i gnas mchog gnas/ /dpal chen gtso bo e ka dza ṭī ma/ /mgon po legs ldan bdud mo re ma ti/ /shan pa srog sgrub gza' mchog rā hu la/

/gnod sbyin dmar nag dam can thig le rtsal/ /ma lus/ bod yul gter bdag lhar bas mched dgu dang*/ / brtan ma bcu gnyis yul lha gzhi bdag sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas rnams/ ma lus/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dha rma pā las sarba sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ mkha' dbyings rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing khams 'dir/ /sgyu ma chu zla ye shes gzhal yas khang*/ /skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang*/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas/ /dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ ngo bo rnam dag chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje kun mkhyen sprul skus 'gro don mdzad/ / brgyud gsum bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos rnams thams cad yid dang sems la 'dus/ /ye nas dbyer med thabs dang shes rab dang*/ / chos dbyings ye shes che la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ / gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga'i bde bar gshegs pa phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos kyi dbyings su dbyer med tshul gcig kyang*/ /phyogs bcu mtha' yas bzhugs pa dus gsum gyi/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' bskyed mdzad pa'i/ /rigs kyi yum chen lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam shes dbang po dag mdzad bde gshegs sras/ /srid pa bla med 'gro ba'i don la brtson/ /nyon mongs spyod pa'i skyon dang rab bral ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar dang*/ /spos mchog mar me la sogs byug pa dri/ /mdzes tshul sku la mchod pas mnyes mdzad pa/ /sems ma chen mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/srid pa gsum gyi yid bzhin bde la rol/ /rgyu drug 'khor ba'i sems can kun sgrol cing*/ /'gro drug drang phyir sprul pa'i sku bstan pa/ /thub pa chen po drug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo skyong ye shes bzhi yi ngang*/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis 'gugs 'ching sdom zhing brdeg /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs 'dzin mnyam nyid kun gyi ngang*/ /rtag chad mthar 'dzin mtshan ma kun sngags shing*/ /mi mthun tshogs 'joms ye shes khro mo'i tshul/ /sgo ma yum chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'jigs byed khrag 'thung he ru'i tshogs/ /ye shes sku mchog 'jigs pa'i chos kyis brgyan/ /nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ye shes dpal gyis thugs/ khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes kyang gcod/ /bka' dang bstan pa gnyen po srung mdzad cing*/ /rnal 'byor dam ldan skyong bar khas blangs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro bka' sdod tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal chen gtso mo e ka dza ṭi ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ru lu'i sgra skad sgrogs/ /kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi ma mo mchog /las dang ye shes tshogs kyi rje mor bstod/ /dpal ldan mgon po mi pham srid gsum dang*/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig /che ba'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /ma hā kā la 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /shin tu mi srun bdud mo re ma ti/ /mun pa'i mdog can dril rta rkang gsum bcibs/ /stong gsum nyul zhing skye 'gro'i srog dbugs len/ /bstan pa srung mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shan pa nag mo mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol/ /snying dang nad kyi rkyal ba phyag na bsnams/ /las byed mkha' 'gro bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /nam gru nag mo 'jigs pa'i tshogs la bstod/ /drang srong chen po gza' mchog rā hu la/

/sku mdog dud kha dbu dgu spyan stong 'bar/ /phyag bzhi mda' gzhur ral gri rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /sring bzhi sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag zangs kyi khyud dmar bcibs/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi gri gug thod khrag dang*/ /ral gri dgra snying sbrul nag zhags pa bsnams/ /drag gtum chen mo 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dam can chen po dmar nag thig le rtsal/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dgra snying bsnams/ /thod phreng g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs gyon/ / 'khor dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /khas blangs dam bcas srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /bod yul gnyer bdag brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*/ /yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dregs pa pho mo ming sring 'khor bcas rnams/ /'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /ye shes grub kyang las kyi pho nyar ston/ /dam can rgyan mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi/ /mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*/ / bdag gis mchod par bshags pa 'di/ /bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dha rma pā la ar+ghaṃ pratīts+tsha swāhā/ /rab 'byams= /zhabs bsil= /bdag gis= /bla ma= /dam can= /'gro ba'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍī ki nī dharma pā la pā d+yaṃ pratīts+tsha swāhā/ /rab 'byams= /me tog= /bdag gis= /bla ma= /dam can= /'gro ba'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dha rma pā la badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ /rab 'byams= / bdug spos= /bdag gis= /bla ma= /dam can= /'gro ba'i= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā kinī dha rma pā la badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/

/rab 'byams= /snang gsal= /bdag gis= /bla ma= /dam can= /'gro ba'i= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dha rma pā la badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ rab 'byams= /dri chab= / bdag gis= /bla ma= /dam can= /'gro ba'i= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki na'i dha rma pā la badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ rab 'byams= /zhal zas= /bdag gis= /bla ma= /dam can= /'gro ba'i= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki na'i dha rmā pā la badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ rab 'byams= /sgra snyan= /bdag gis= / bla ma= /dam can= /'gro ba'i= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dha rma pā la badz+ra shab+da āḥhūṃ/ nang mchod ni/ hūṃ/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs yid 'ong gzugs/ rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su kun sbrul te/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dha rma pā la rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs yid 'ong sgra/ rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ bla ma= /thugs rjes= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= /badz+ra shab+da kā ma gu ṇa= /snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs dri zhim spos/ rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs= /bla ma= /thugs rjes= /oṃ sarba= /gan+dhe kā ma= /snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs ro ldan zas= /rdo rje ri ma'i= /bla ma= /thugs rjes= /oṃ sarba= /nai wid+ya kā ma= /snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs ro ldan zas= /rdo rje reg ma'i= /bla ma= /thugs rjes= /oṃ sarba= /nai wi d+ya kā la/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs bde ba'i reg /rdo rje reg ma'i= /bla ma= /thugs rjes= /oṃ sarba= /sbar+she kā ma= /gsang mchod ni= /hūm̐/ gsang mchog bde chen sku yi rig ma ni/ /sku mdog dkar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams/ /shin tu yid 'ong bde gshegs mnyes mdzad ma/ /gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhis su gsol/
/oṃ badz+rā dar+sha āḥhūṃ/ gsang mchog gsung gi bde chen rig ma ni/

/ sku mdog dmar ser rnga zlum sgra sgrogs ma/ shin tu yid 'ong = gsang mchog bde ba'i = oṃ badz+ra mu rañdzi āḥhūṃ/ gsang mchog thugs kyi bdag = sku mdog mthing mdzes pi waṃ = shin tu yid 'ong= /gsang mchog= /oṃ badz+ra bī ni āḥhūṃ/ gsang mchog yon tan bde= /sku mdog ser mdzes gling bu'i sgra= /shin tu yid 'ong = /gsang mchod bde ba'i= /oṃ badz+ra waṃ se āḥhūṃ/ gsang mchog phrin las= /sku mdog ljang mdzes rdza rnga'i sgra= /shin tu yid 'ong = /gsang chog= /oṃ badz+ra min+dha āḥhūm̐= /hūm̐ dung chen ye shes lnga yi gzhal yas su/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i a mṛ ta/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho mnyes byed 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma'i zhal= gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i zhal= rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal= phyag chen brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal= gtso yul brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du= bskyed rdzogs brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal= mdo sngabs brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal= zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis zhal= khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad zhal= ye shes las grub mkha' 'gro'i zhal= dpal ldan sngags kyi srung ma'i zhal= mgon po legs ldan nag po'i zhal= shan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i zhal= gza'i dge bsnyen chen po'i zhal= gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag zhal= dam can rdo rje legs pa'i zhal= gter bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i zhing = lha rabs mched dgu 'khor bcas zhal= 'dzam gling brtan ma bcu gnyis zhal= gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī kā ya/ wak tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūṃ/ zhal zas sna tshogs gtor chen la/ / sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rgyan ldan/ / dri mchog ro brgya ldan pa yi/

/ba liṃ rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta ri kā hi/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i zhal= zhes pa bdud rtsi 'bul ba dang mtshungs so/ /rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rgyud drug rang bzhin dbyings su bsgral ba'i khrag /rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i zhal= oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes gtor ma 'bul ba dang mtshungs so/ /bstod pa gong gi phyag 'tshal byed do/ /bsnyen sgrub ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su a dmar po'i mtha' skor du bo dhi tsit+ta'i sngags dang oṃ ru lu ru lu'i sngags phreng g.yon skor du 'khor ba las/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i bsnyen sgrub bya'o/ /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nya na dhā tu āḥ zhes brgya dang*/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya stong du mas sgrub pa bya'o/ /tshogs mchod ni/ las kyi slob mas phyag rgya phrin sngags ni/ ho dgongs su gsol lo/ /snang srid bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'dod yon rgyan gyi mchod pas rol pa'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi yo byad byin gyis rlob bar zhu/ 'tshal/ bdud rtsis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ hūm̐/ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /chos rnams sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir/ /dngos dang dngos 'dzin bag chags kun/ /yi ge ram̐ kham̐ yam̐ gsum gyis/ /bsreg cing bkrus ye gtor byas nas/ /dag par ma gyur gang yang med/ /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥtrām̐/ yi ge rnam lnga'i rang bzhinalas/ /zhal zas dngos po yi ge lnga/ / yi ge sgra dang bcas pa yi/ /tshogs kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu/ /'od phung 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i thugs dam skong gyur cig

/gu ru de wa shān+tiṃ kro dha ḍā ki nī e ka dza ṭī ma hā kā la re ma ti khyi kha le ma ru ma tse badz+ra sa dhu sarba sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa ni/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ brgyud rim gong dang*/ bshags pa ni/ ho dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas/ /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam las 'gal zhing nyams par gyur to 'tshal/ /rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /thog med bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas/ /tshor dang ma tshor nyams chag ci mchis pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i spyan sngar bshags par bgyi/ /tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bsnyen sgrub ma tshang phud dang gtsang sbra nyams/ /dus su ma mchod le lo gsog 'jogs bgyis/ /lta ba ma rtogs sgom pa ma gsal zhing*/ /spyod pa bag med bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /bla ma mched lcam rdo rje spun la smad/ /sdig dang nyon mongs rang gar gyur to 'tshal/ /'phral dang yun gyi sgrib pa ci mchis pa/ /rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /yi ge brgya pa bzla'o/ /tshogs drang ba ni/ hoḥ dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol/ /'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /len pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs/ /gzung 'dzin rnam par bral ba yi/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /a la la hoḥ de nas tshogs lhag gtong ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir gyur/ /hūm̐/ chos rnams mnyam nyid klong yangs su/ / phud dang lhag ma gcig tu bsre/ /thams cad kun bzang rol pa'i rgyan/ / mchod par mi 'os gang yang med/ /dang por phud kyis mi mchod du/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas phud la dgyes/

/bar du tshogs kyis mi bskang du/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro tshogs la dgyes/ /tha mar lhag mas mi brngan du/ /srid bzhi sde brgyad lhag la dgyes/ /phud la dgyes pa phud la rol/ /tshogs la dgyes pa tshogs la rol/ /lha ma dgyes pa lhag la rol/ /dgyes shi grub pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ de nas gtor ma dpags la chad thob btang ba ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la/ /'og min dga' ldan zhes bya'i gnas mchog tu/ /bcom ldan dpal chen khrag 'thung chen po yis/ /snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /ke seng rta gdong sring mor bcas rnams kyis/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang*/ /rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas su/ /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam/ /rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan zlog par ma chad dam/ / sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i bar ma la/ /bal yul yang le shod kyi gnas mchog tu/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ /mkhas pa'i mnga' bdag bi ma mi tra yis/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi srung ma yongs 'dus nas/ /so so'i= /rang rang = /bka' yi= /bcol pa'i= /rnal 'byor= /rgyu sbyor= /sngon tshe= /sha khrag= /thugs dam= /de 'og tha ma bskal pa'i snyigs ma la/ /yar klung sham po gangs kyi ra ba ru/ / rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza dang*/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ /sngags srung gza' dang dam can yongs 'dus nas/ so so'i= /rang rang = /bka' yi= / bcol pa'i= /rnal 'byor= /rgyu sbyor= /sngon tshe= /sha khrag= /thugs dam=

/ ma ma hrīng hrīng a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes bshal chus brtan ma bskyang ngo*/ /oṃ yedharmā nas/ shra ma ṇa swā hā/ shis brjod ni/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gis rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dbus kyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha/ /rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis don gyi lha/ /de bzhin rigs kyi bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /shar gyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis don gyi lha/ /rdo rje rigs kyi= /bkra shis= /lho yi phyogs nas= /rin chen 'byung gnas bkra shis= /rin chen rigs kyi bkra shis gang lags pa bkra shis= /nub kyi phyogs nas bkra shis= /snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis= /pad+ma rigs kyi bkra shis gang = /bkra shis= /byang gi phyogs nas= /don yod grub pa= /las kyi rigs kyi= /bkra shis= /rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsam pa dang*/ /gsang sngags rig sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*/ / bden pa smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis/ /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*/ /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /snyan grags nam mkha' bzhin du khyab gyur pa'i/ /gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs nas bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing sogs bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing sogs shog / 'byung po gang dag sogs spyod par shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sogs shog / bcom ldan 'das kyis spyan snga ru/ /sgrub par mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/

/rgyal chen bzhi yi bkra shig shog / nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ /sogs bkra shis shog / tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur nas/ /dge legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa'i/ / sogs shog /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /sogs bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /sogs dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis brjod/ bzod par gsol ba ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gtso bo'i nus pa ma mchis pa/ /'dir ni bgyis pa gang lags pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /yi ge brgya pa bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ /dam tshig pa dkyil 'khor gtso bo la bsdu/ /gtso bo thugs ka'i sa bon la mi dmigs par bzlu'o/ /slar yang sgo gsum khyer so gsun du bya'o/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs te/ /sring na 'ga' yang mi gnas shing*/ /thams cad sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog / rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /de ltar zhi khro'i sgrub dkyil rim pa zhig /mdo tsam brjod las bsod nams gang thob pa/ /de yis 'gro kun tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i go 'phang myur thob shog /deng sang 'gro ba tshig nyung don 'dus pa'i/ /tshul la mos phyir tshig nyung man ngag 'dis/ /skal ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i sgrub dkyil rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gangs ri thod dkar mgul o rgyan rdzong du bkod pa rdzogs so//
//dge'o/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (25) rgyal ba zhi khro'i sgrub dkyil rin po che'i gter mdzod/ -PAGE 362-- PAGE 363 - - PAGE 360 -
